QA_Gate.role: Quality Assurance Gate – not a user-facing agent, but an automated middleware stage that fact-checks and refines agents’ outputs:contentReference[oaicite:100]{index=100}
QA_Gate.function: Performs final answer validation: checks factual accuracy, completeness, tone, and can correct the response before it’s sent to user:contentReference[oaicite:101]{index=101}:contentReference[oaicite:102]{index=102}
QA_Gate.implementation: Runs as Express middleware (`qaGateMiddleware`) on critical routes (e.g. media generation, orchestrated chat):contentReference[oaicite:103]{index=103}:contentReference[oaicite:104]{index=104}. Currently uses a GPT-4 based "QA expert" prompt to analyze and optionally correct responses:contentReference[oaicite:105]{index=105}:contentReference[oaicite:106]{index=106}
QA_Gate.outputs: Appends a QA score (0.0–1.0) and a pass/fail flag. If quality is below threshold (e.g. <0.8), it attempts to adjust the answer (wasCorrected=true):contentReference[oaicite:107]{index=107}:contentReference[oaicite:108]{index=108}. All QA results are logged for review:contentReference[oaicite:109]{index=109}:contentReference[oaicite:110]{index=110}
QA_Gate.routes: Integrated into `/api/enhanced-agent/chat` processing pipeline and media routes (via `qaGateMiddleware`):contentReference[oaicite:111]{index=111}:contentReference[oaicite:112]{index=112}. Can be toggled via config flags (e.g. QA_ENABLED):contentReference[oaicite:113]{index=113}
